name: LINE FEED
description: This is the ASCII/Unicode 10 (0x0A).

name: LINE TABULATION
description: Also used as a line separator by Microsoft Word and Powerpoint which use it to contrast with the character used as a paragraph separator (sources: http://stackoverflow.com/questions/3380538/what-is-a-vertical-tab http://unicode.org/reports/tr13/tr13-9.html )

name: CARRIAGE RETURN
description: This is the ASCII/Unicode 13 (0x0D). Used as a paragraph separator by Microsoft Word and Powerpoint (source: https://web.archive.org/web/20080325092316/http://support.microsoft.com/kb/59096).

name: FULL STOP
description: Full stop or decimal point

name: NEXT LINE
description: This is the Unicode U+0085. May semantically indicate a new paragraph. To indicate unambiguously a new line without a new paragraph, use 295 New line within paragraph. To indicate unambiguously a new paragraph, use 294 Paragraph separator.

name: Begin separator
description: Begin a DCE separator string.

name: End separator
description: End a DCE separator string.

name: Range
description: The DCE range character. Used to represent ranges in DCE. See the wiki for more information.

name: Record summation
description: Used to denote the union of two records. See the wiki for more information.

name: Begin number
description: Begin a DCE number.

name: End number
description: End a DCE number.

name: Unknown value
description: Substitution character for an unknown value.

name: Gregorian calendar identifier
description: Internal DCE calendar identifier for the Gregorian calendar.

name: Positive
description: Positive value (syntactical representation — This is not the + character)

name: Negative
description: Negative (syntactical representation — This is not the − character)

name: Full drop back
description: Drop back to the core sheet (no meaning in EDF)

name: Drop back
description: Drop back to the enclosing sheet (no meaning in EDF)

name: Begin DCE content
description: Begins a DCE region (no meaning in EDF)

name: No mapping
description: Processing use only (not for interchange)

name: Space
description: Sometimes used as a visible word separator, e.g. in Anoej

name: Latin Letter Uppercase I
description: Special casing considerations for Turkish

name: Latin Letter Lowercase I
description: Special casing considerations for Turkish

name: Vertical line
description: Glyph might use a solid or broken line. U+00A6 seems to be unambiguously broken; Unicode doesn't seem to provide an unambiguously solid one.

name: Begin unbounded content
description: This denotes content that is not "bound" (given a context of a page, etc. to be within) — in other words it is what a plain text file is to a word processing file with page formatting — content with no context given for presenting it

name: Ambiguous vertical tabulation
description: Also used as a line separator by Microsoft Word and Powerpoint which use it to contrast with the character used as a paragraph separator (sources: http://stackoverflow.com/questions/3380538/what-is-a-vertical-tab http://unicode.org/reports/tr13/tr13-9.html )

name: New line
description: This is the Unicode U+0085. May semantically indicate a new paragraph. To indicate unambiguously a new line without a new paragraph, use 295 New line within paragraph. To indicate unambiguously a new paragraph, use 294 Paragraph separator.

name: Ambiguous line feed
description: This is the ASCII/Unicode 10 (0x0A).

name: Ambiguous carriage return
description: This is the ASCII/Unicode 13 (0x0D). Used as a paragraph separator by Microsoft Word and Powerpoint (source: https://web.archive.org/web/20080325092316/http://support.microsoft.com/kb/59096).

name: Begin encapsulated UTF-8
description: Begin Base 64 encapsulated UTF-8

name: End encapsulated UTF-8
description: End Base 64 encapsulated UTF-8

name: Begin keyed embed fragment
description: This Dc is used for embedding arbitrary keyed ID/data pairs in a document. Standard structure: Followed by base64-encoded data identifying a fragment, then Dc 202 (End keyed embed ID sequence), then by the base64-encoded fragment itself, then by Dc 201 (End keyed embed fragment).

name: End keyed embed fragment
description: See description for 200

name: End keyed embed ID sequence
description: See description for 200

name: Begin encapsulated binary data
description: Arbitrary binary data (base64 encoded, no semantic significance assigned to it)

name: End encapsulated binary data
description: See description for 203

name: Unicode replacement character
description: Used to replace an incoming character whose value is unknown or unrepresentable in Unicode

name: Replacement character for unavailable Dc
description: Used to replace an incoming character whose value is not mapped to a Dc (document component)

name: Begin document
description: Beginning of a document

name: Line feed
description: This character instructs a terminal to move the cursor to the beginning of the line horizontally without advancing to the next line vertically. This character is not directly equivalent to ASCII line feed, because that is sometimes used for a combined new line and carriage return. For representing the ASCII line feed, use Dc 120.

name: Carriage return
description: This character instructs a terminal to advance to the next line vertically without moving the cursor to the beginning of the line horizontally. This character is not directly equivalent to ASCII carriage return, because that is sometimes used for a combined new line and carriage return. For representing the ASCII carriage return, use Dc 121.

name: Switch to Document mode
description: Indicates that the following contents expect a graphical raster display output.

name: Switch to Library mode
description: Indicates that the following contents provide resources (such as routine, class, or other definitions) for consumption by other documents.

name: Switch to Structured mode
description: Indicates that the following contents represent structured data.

name: Switch to Terminal mode
description: Indicates that the following contents expect a character-based terminal display output.

name: Switch to Web mode
description: Indicates that the following contents are designed to respond to a Web request (in a manner similar to a PHP or CGI script).

name: Begin single-line source comment on current line
description: Begins a comment that, when represented in EM (Ember Language source) format, should be displayed as a “#”-style comment. All characters except 248 and 255 will be ignored. Use 255 248 to represent 248 within the comment, and 255 255 to represent 255 within the comment.

name: Begin single-line source comment on new line
description: As with 247, but starting on a new line in the source form.

name: End single-line source comment
description: Terminates a comment region begun by 246 or 247.

name: Begin block source comment on current line
description: As with 248, but creating a “/*  */”-style block comment.

name: Begin block source comment on new line
description: As with 250, but starting on a new line in the source form.

name: End block source comment
description: Terminates a comment region begun by 249 or 250.

name: Join to next source line
description: Indicates that a line break that would normally be present at this point in source form should be instead represented by a ;.

name: Split source line here
description: Indicates that the current logical line should be split into two physical lines in source form, joined using \.

name: Braced block in source
description: Indicates that the following logical block of statements should be bundled onto a single line of the source, joined using ; and bundled using { and }.

name: Ignore following Dc
description: Indicates that the next character should be ignored.

name: void lang.say(String)
description: Send the specified string to the current output context, adding a final line feed if one is not present

name: Built-in type identifier: String
description: A specific case of “String” as a format (short-style format ID 80)

name: void lang.invoke(String)
description: Invoke the routine with the given name

name: void lang.block
description: Indicates a division between blocks of statements

name: Whitespace in source
description: Indicates that in source form, there is FIXME: following amount of whitespace., a blank line should be present here

name: Leave block level
description: Indicates the point at which an indented block is left and execution returns to the enclosing block

name: Parameter modifier: Parameter should be slurpy
Built-in type identifier: * (Object or any subtype)
Routine invocation
description: Invoke the specified routine (unlike lang.invoke, this form of invocation is not shown in the EM source form of the document FIXME: clarify this??)

name: New line within paragraph
description: This is the Unicode U+2028. It refers to a non-paragraph-separator newline, usually within a paragraph.

name: Paragraph separator
description: This is the Unicode U+2029.

name: Next number is a Dc-equivalent reference to a local node/document
Next number is a Dc-equivalent reference to a global node to which this local node was moved.
Begin associativity group
description: Equivalent to an opening parenthesis in many languages or in arithmetic expressions.

name: End associativity group
description: Equivalent to a closing parenthesis in many languages or in arithmetic expressions.

name: Type union
description: Indicates that two types are both applicable to data.

name: Type transformation
description: Describes a transformation operation as part of a type description. Only “transformation” formats would make sense to use with this.

name: Type conversion
description: Describes a conversion operation from one type to another.

name: Type transmutation
description: Describes a transmutation operation (reinterpreting one type as another without converting).

name: Built-in type identifier: Routine name
description: Subtype of string

name: Next number is a long (global graph) Dc
description: Used to embed Dcs with short numbers greater than 1,114,111 (the largest, in practice, that EITE would be able to support without needing changes to pack32, I think) into short Dc range. If encountered as a long Dc, it must be escaped with 255 before converting to short Dc, or else it would be lost (if followed by a Dc number) when converting back.

name: Solid vertical line
description: Glyph variant of U+007C. Broken variant is unambiguously U+00A6.

name: Begin list of type
description: Begins an ordered, contiguous, typed homogenous or heterogenous list.

name: End list of type
description: Terminates a typed list begun by 310.

name: List element separator
description: Separates elements within a list or sequence.

name: Begin key-value map
description: Begins a key-value associative map.

name: End key-value map
description: Terminates a key-value associative map begun by 313.

name: Optional value present
description: Indicates an optional value is present.

name: Optional value absent
description: Indicates an optional value is absent.

name: Begin file
description: Begins a universal file representation record.

name: End file
description: Terminates a universal file representation record.

name: Begin file identity
description: Begins a file identity descriptor.

name: End file identity
description: Terminates a file identity descriptor.

name: Begin file metadata
description: Begins a file metadata record.

name: End file metadata
description: Terminates a file metadata record.

name: Begin file stream
description: Begins an attached or alternate data stream record.

name: End file stream
description: Terminates an attached or alternate data stream record.

name: Begin file kind description
description: Begins a description of the kind of a file. Note that this is different from the data format of a file.

name: End file kind description
description: Terminates a file kind description.

name: File system node identifier
description: Filesystem inode number or equivalent unique node ID.

name: Storage device identifier
description: Filesystem device ID on which the file resides.

name: File modification timestamp
description: Modification timestamp of a file in nanoseconds since Unix epoch.

name: File access timestamp
description: Access timestamp of a file in nanoseconds since Unix epoch.

name: File creation timestamp

name: File status change timestamp

name: File permissions mode

name: File owner user identifier

name: File owner group identifier
description: Group ID of the file group.

name: File payload size

name: File primary path

name: File stream name

name: File target link path

name: End execution environment description

name: Operating system description

name: Collective Toolbox build version

name: Architecture pointer bit width description

name: Working directory path

name: Host local network IP address

name: System clock resolution nanoseconds
